content:
**Camp Liberty** is a location in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Skyline Valley* update.

Located in the southeastern part of Skyline Valley, Camp Liberty is bordered by a river and a lake to the north. The main entrance, along with a small parking lot, is on the western side, with a road connecting it to the rest of the valley.

The camp itself can be broken down into three sections:

Heading east past the main entrance, a Notice Board holds two notes, Camp Recruitment Drive and Stony Man Lookout Assault. Further east is a gate, flanked by two guard posts. Past the gate is a totem pole, whose engravings read "Summer Camp" and "Welcome." From here, there are several points of interest:

Outside the Mess Hall and next to its northern wall, there is a pyre that has several burned books, as well as another note, Camp Fire Tale. To the east is a large open-air stage that has a projector, which plays a Pioneer Scouts movie on repeat. A climbable guard tower is located to the right of the stage, while a cage with a variant of Yao Guai and an "Animal in Training" sign is to the left of it.

Going up the southern path from the totem pole, one reaches an open area on the cliff, with the Camping Zone being located to the southeast and some derelict cabins to the southwest.

The Camping Zone consists of several large tents, and a Cooking Station in form of a Cooking Spit at is center. The tent to the west of the Cooking Spit holds two more notes, namely entries two and three of Ben's Diary. The tent to the east of the Cooking Spit has a Caps Stash. To the north of the Cooking Spit is the Expedition Leader's cabin, which contains the Council Member Terminal, a Level-1 locked Safe and another note, Operation Sleeping Giant.

Going northwest from the totem pole, one reaches the Activity Center 1, a long shack that has an Armor Workbench on the veranda, as well as a Chemistry Station and a Weapons Workbench inside the actual shack. Two paths lead in different directions, a makeshift wooden bridge northward across to the river, and an eastern path through a small picnic area to a set of stairs, and subsequently to a makeshift prison build around a Basketball field.

In front of the prison are several items of interest. On the left side are another note, Prison Incident Report, on a desk, as well as a Red Menace holotape on a small stand, next to a Level-1 locked Safe containing contraband. On the right side is another Notice Board, containing additional copies of Camp Recruitment Drive and Stony Man Lookout Assault. Inside the prison is a small cell that holds a deceased Park Ranger and a note, Final Words.

To the east of the prison is a training course, which contains several obstacles and Mannequins, the latter of which can be used to practice the stabbing of enemies. The final obstacle is "The Eliminator," a large climbing tower with a zip line, that connects to a small island in the middle of the lake - which is the home to a hostile Commie Bear.

Several pontoons are in the water north of the training course. By jumping them, a pier on the other side of the river can be reached to the north. West of the pier is an inaccessible shack with some Canoes, and further west, an archery range. To the south is the wooden bridge that leads back to the Activity Center 1.
